scripts.init: docker compose run --rm -T zephyr sh -c 'test -d /opt/zephyr-workspace/.west || west init -l /workspace /opt/zephyr-workspace'
scripts.update: docker compose run --rm -T -w /opt/zephyr-workspace zephyr west update
scripts.build: docker compose run --rm -T -w /opt/zephyr-workspace zephyr west build -b native_sim /workspace/src/smoke -d /workspace/build
scripts.test: docker compose run --rm -T -w /opt/zephyr-workspace zephyr west build -t run -b native_sim /workspace/src/smoke -d /workspace/build
scripts.smoke: npm run init && npm run update && npm run build
scripts.flash: docker compose --profile flash run --rm -w /opt/zephyr-workspace flash west flash -d /workspace/build
scripts.deploy: docker compose --profile flash run --rm -w /opt/zephyr-workspace flash west flash -d /workspace/build
